title: 古拉加斯·山路行者
description: 红胡子古拉加斯穿完整厚衣，在宽阔山路旁停步，大木桶稳放地面，体格与粗蜡笔硬光形面鲜明。

art_direction.medium: angular wax-crayon strokes, directional hatching and dramatic hard-edged light on textured paper
art_direction.identity: Gragas is a very large broad adult man with a thick ginger beard, a bald crown with red hair at the sides, a broad nose, and a heavy powerful build. Preserve his immense barrel-like silhouette and huge wooden cask while clothing him in a fully covering substantial shirt, dark vest, opaque trousers, and boots, without exposed belly or drunken expression.
art_direction.scene: Place him standing beside his securely grounded cask on an expansive mountain road overlook, one hand resting on its rim and his gaze fixed on the far valley. The pose is calm and solid, without drinking. Hard warm side light creates decisive beard and cloth planes in coarse wax, with simple blue ridges and open atmospheric distance behind him.
art_direction.palette: ginger red, dark pine, wood brown, pale gold light
art_direction.weapon_policy: iconic static prop, no attacks or firing

visual_qa.method: up to ten images on a compressed JPEG contact sheet, max edge 1280
